description: Restart-only V-009 receipt: reuse an already installed and enabled Needler mod without copying, packing, removing, or replacing any fixture, then prove the second client process rebuilds the same editable weapon/effect/audio runtime closure and dispatches it through ordinary gameplay.

input_sequence.comment: Second process starts from the preserved install; this scenario intentionally declares no fixtures, packed_fixtures, or remove_paths.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_AIM_DOWN
input_sequence.comment: Aim through the normal semantic action path.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_FIRE_MODE
input_sequence.comment: Select the public secondary function after restart.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_FIRE_PRIMARY
input_sequence.comment: Fire the selected public projectile into ordinary world collision.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_AIM_DOWN
input_sequence.comment: Release normal aim input after impact.
Leave enough time for the second-process effect, audio, presentation, and renderer receipts.

required_lines: modmgr: discovered mod \[\d+\] 'needler'.*\[\.pdmod\] from 'installed' file=.*installed.*needler\.pdmod sha256=[0-9a-f]+\.\.
SETUP: user-picked spawn weapon 'mod_needler:needler' num=\d+ preserved
EFFECT\.GAMEPLAY\.AUDIT: committed asset=mod_needler:pink_burst_effect instance=\d+ explosion=1 spark=1 smoke=0 particle=0 audio=1 audio_id=mod_needler:pink_burst_sfx soundnum=\d+ channel=\d+
EFFECT\.INSTANCE\.AUDIT: committed asset=mod_needler:pink_burst_effect instance=\d+ consumers=2 lifetime=1\.500
EFFECT\.PRESENTATION\.RENDER\.AUDIT: instance=\d+ snapshots=[1-9]\d* channel=2 shader=needler_pink_burst intensity=
BONDGUN\.SOURCE: loaded catalog model source filenum=\d+ id=mod_needler:needler_model path=.*needler\.pdweapon::dependencies/assets/models/weapon\.pdmesh::model\.gltf
MODASSET\.RENDER: generated source modeldef rendered id=mod_needler:needler_model source=.*dependencies/assets/models/weapon\.pdmesh::model\.gltf
forbidden_patterns: weapon_graph_runtime: held IR unavailable for mod_needler:needler
